Maghanap at mag-apply para sa part-time na trabaho

entries.source: কাজ খুঁজুন → Original site খুলুন → আবেদন করুন
entries.target: Maghanap ng trabaho → Buksan ang Original site → Mag-apply

entries.source: TownWork ও Baitoru-তে Tokyo-এর পার্ট-টাইম কাজ খুঁজে কীভাবে আবেদন করবেন—একদম শুরু থেকে বাংলায় দেখানো হয়েছে। আপনার নিহোন কোনো চাকরির আবেদন নিজে নেয় না।
entries.target: Ipinapakita dito mula sa simula sa Filipino kung paano maghanap at mag-apply para sa part-time na trabaho sa Tokyo sa TownWork at Baitoru. Ang আপনার নিহোন ay hindi tumatanggap ng anumang aplikasyon sa trabaho mismo.

entries.source: আপনার Nihon-এ TownWork/Baitoru password দেবেন না। Apply করলে সবসময় original website-এই form পূরণ করবেন।
entries.target: Huwag ibigay ang iyong password ng TownWork/Baitoru sa আপনার নিহোন. Kapag mag-a-apply ka, palaging punan ang form sa original website.

entries.source: Tokyo এবং আপনার পছন্দের কাজ/এলাকা বেছে নিন।
entries.target: Piliin ang Tokyo at ang trabaho/lugar na gusto mo.

entries.source: TownWork বা Baitoru-এর official page-এ job details পড়ুন।
entries.target: Basahin ang job details sa official page ng TownWork o Baitoru.

entries.source: 応募する / 応募へ চাপুন এবং original form পূরণ করুন।
entries.target: Pindutin ang 応募する / 応募へ at punan ang original form.

entries.source: নিচের button চাপলে সরাসরি official source খুলবে। কোনো job data আপনার Nihon-এ copy করা হচ্ছে না।
entries.target: Kapag pinindot mo ang button sa ibaba, direktang magbubukas ang official source. Walang job data na kinokopya sa আপনার নিহোন.

entries.source: Tokyo-এর বিভিন্ন baito খুঁজুন। Original site-এ গিয়ে area, station, job type, salary ও shift filter করুন।
entries.target: Maghanap ng iba't ibang baito sa Tokyo. Sa original site, i-filter ayon sa area, station, job type, salary at shift.
Buksan ang TownWork at tingnan ang

entries.source: Tokyo-এর baito browse করুন। Convenience store ও restaurant-এর direct category-ও নিচে দেওয়া আছে।
entries.target: Mag-browse ng baito sa Tokyo. Ibinigay din sa ibaba ang direct category para sa convenience store at restaurant.

entries.source: filter ব্যবহার করলে দ্রুত উপযুক্ত job পাওয়া যায়।
entries.target: filter ay makakatulong sa iyo na mabilis na makahanap ng angkop na trabaho.

entries.source: প্রথমে একটি category খুলুন। তারপর original site-এ নিজের station/সময় দিয়ে আরও narrow করুন।
entries.target: Una, magbukas ng isang category. Pagkatapos, sa original site, paliitin pa ito gamit ang iyong station/oras.

entries.source: Button-এর নাম একটু বদলাতে পারে, কিন্তু মূল flow প্রায় একই।
entries.target: Maaaring bahagyang magbago ang pangalan ng Button, ngunit halos pareho ang pangunahing flow.
Buksan ang trabahong gusto mo at

entries.source: নাম, ふりがな, email, phone ইত্যাদি
entries.target: Pangalan, ふりがな, email, phone, atbp.

entries.source: 入力内容確認 (তথ্য যাচাই) screen-এ ভুল আছে কি না দেখুন।
entries.target: Sa screen ng 入力内容確認 (beripikasyon ng impormasyon), tingnan kung may mali.

entries.source: Submit করার পর employer-এর phone/email-এর জন্য অপেক্ষা করুন।
entries.target: Pagkatapos mag-Submit, hintayin ang phone/email ng employer.

entries.source: Job detail-এ interview location ও contact method আলাদা থাকতে পারে। Submit করার আগে screenshot রেখে দিতে পারেন।
entries.target: Sa Job detail, maaaring magkahiwalay ang interview location at contact method. Maaari kang magtago ng screenshot bago mag-Submit.

entries.source: Job খুলে salary, shift, location ও 応募条件 ভালোভাবে পড়ুন।
entries.target: Buksan ang Job at basahing mabuti ang salary, shift, location at 応募条件.

entries.source: চাপুন। Login/registration screen এলে নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করুন।
entries.target: Pindutin ito. Kung may lumabas na Login/registration screen, sundin ang mga tagubilin.

entries.source: দেখালে email দিয়ে account তৈরি/লগইন করুন।
entries.target: kung ipinakita, gumawa ng account / mag-login gamit ang email.

entries.source: Application form-এ নিজের নাম, phone, email ও প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য দিন।
entries.target: Sa Application form, ibigay ang iyong pangalan, phone, email at kinakailangang impormasyon.

entries.source: 確認 → 応募完了 হলে employer-এর contact-এর জন্য অপেক্ষা করুন।
entries.target: Kapag 確認 → 応募完了 na, hintayin ang contact ng employer.

entries.source: Password শুধু Baitoru/dip-এর original page-এ দিন। Aponar Nihon কখনো আপনার password চাইবে না।
entries.target: Ibigay lamang ang Password sa original page ng Baitoru/dip. Hinding-hindi hihingin ng Aponar Nihon ang iyong password.
Unawain ang Japanese sa Application form

entries.source: সবচেয়ে বেশি দেখা যায় এমন field-এর সহজ বাংলা অর্থ।
entries.target: Madaling kahulugan sa Filipino ng mga field na pinakamadalas makita.

entries.source: এই শব্দগুলো জানলে job ad বুঝতে সহজ হবে
entries.target: Kung alam mo ang mga salitang ito, mas madaling mauunawaan ang job ad

entries.source: অভিজ্ঞতা না থাকলেও আবেদন করা যায়

entries.target: Tingnan ang 4 na bagay bago mag-Apply

entries.source: আপনার school/অন্যান্য schedule-এর সাথে মিলছে কি?
entries.target: Tugma ba ito sa iyong school/ibang schedule?

entries.source: শেষ train এবং commute time দেখে নিন।
entries.target: Tingnan ang huling train at commute time.

entries.source: কাজের জন্য দরকারি ভাষার level বুঝে আবেদন করুন।
entries.target: Mag-apply nang nauunawaan ang level ng wika na kailangan para sa trabaho.

entries.source: আপনার residence status/permission অনুযায়ী কাজ করা যায় কি না নিশ্চিত করুন।
entries.target: Tiyakin kung maaari kang magtrabaho ayon sa iyong residence status/permission.

entries.source: শান্তভাবে নিজের নাম বলুন এবং interview-এর date/time লিখে রাখুন।
entries.target: Sabihin ang iyong pangalan nang mahinahon at isulat ang date/time ng interview.

entries.source: Common প্রশ্ন, shift answer ও phone script আগে practice করুন।
entries.target: Mag-practice muna ng mga karaniwang tanong, shift answer at phone script.

entries.source: TownWork/Baitoru login password বা application-এর sensitive তথ্য Aponar Nihon-এ দেবেন না।
entries.target: Huwag ibigay sa Aponar Nihon ang login password ng TownWork/Baitoru o sensitibong impormasyon ng application.

entries.source: Apply করার আগে browser-এর domain দেখে নিশ্চিত হন যে আপনি original TownWork/Baitoru page-এ আছেন।
entries.target: Bago mag-Apply, tingnan ang domain ng browser at tiyakin na nasa original TownWork/Baitoru page ka.

entries.source: নিজের residence status, school rules এবং work permission মেনে কাজ বেছে নিন।
entries.target: Pumili ng trabaho na sumusunod sa iyong residence status, school rules at work permission.

entries.source: Aponar Nihon হলো বাংলা guide ও official-source launcher; employer বা job platform নয়।
entries.target: Ang Aponar Nihon ay isang gabay sa Filipino at official-source launcher; hindi ito employer o job platform.
